symbols.name: prime radix
symbols.meaning: The radix of the stored digits, a prime (not a sequence length).
symbols.quote: Fix a prime $q$, the radix of the stored digits; this $q$ is a prime radix, not a sequence length as on the cyclic convolution and discrete Fourier transform pages.

symbols.name: field digit count
symbols.meaning: The number of base-q digits of a field.
symbols.quote: Let $b\ge1$ be the number of base-$q$ digits of a field; this $b$ is not the lowest bit of an output index as on the butterfly page.

symbols.name: field value count
symbols.meaning: The number of values a field can take.
symbols.quote: Put $Q=q^b$, the number of values a field can take.

symbols.name: field value
symbols.meaning: The value of the target field, an integer from 0 to Q-1 (not the ring variable).
symbols.quote: The target field has value $y\in\{0,\dots,Q-1\}$; here $y$ is a field value, not the ring variable.

symbols.name: offset
symbols.meaning: The offset added to the target field, prepared from the control values.
symbols.quote: where $a$ is the offset prepared from the control values; this $a$ is not a bank index.

symbols.name: suffix digit count
symbols.meaning: The number of digits following the target field.
symbols.quote: Let $B$ be the number of digits that follow the target; this $B$ is not the number of entries per row on the stream-operations page.

symbols.name: scaling multiplier
symbols.meaning: A fixed positive integer prime to q by which the field is multiplied.
symbols.quote: Let $c$ be a fixed positive integer prime to $q$.

symbols.name: wrap count
symbols.meaning: The number of times cy wraps past Q.
symbols.quote: where $j=\lfloor cy/Q\rfloor$ is the number of times $cy$ wraps past $Q$; this $j$ is not a digit value as on the stream-operations page.

symbols.name: scaled position
symbols.meaning: The position cy - jQ to which the block at position y is sent.
symbols.quote: The map $y\mapsto cy \pmod Q$ sends the block at position $y$ to position $y'=cy-jQ$, where $j=\lfloor cy/Q\rfloor$ is the number of times $cy$ wraps past $Q$; this $j$ is not a digit value as on the stream-operations page.

symbols.name: unit denominator
symbols.meaning: The positive integer denominator of a rational unit, prime to q.
symbols.quote: A rational unit is a signed ratio $c/c'$ of positive integers $c,c'$ both prime to $q$.

relations.quote: Each operation below is carried out by splitting into streams and merging back, as in [Elementary stream operations](stream-ops.md).
